about.heading: ABOUT
about.intro: Convert-it is a free, open-source universal file converter that runs entirely in your browser. No uploads, no servers, no signups — your files never leave your device.
about.intro2: Built for developers, designers, and anyone who needs quick, private file conversions without the hassle of sketchy online tools or bloated desktop software.

step1.title: Drag & Drop
step1.desc: Drop your files or click to browse. Convert-it auto-detects the format and suggests available conversions.

step2.title: Customize
step2.desc: Tweak quality, delimiter, bitrate, or preset settings per file before converting.

step3.title: Download
step3.desc: Get your converted file instantly. Download individually or zip all results at once.

about.privacy1: Your files never leave your browser. All conversion happens locally using WebAssembly and the Canvas API. We don't upload, store, or have any access to your data.
about.privacy2: We run no analytics or tracking scripts — no cookies, no fingerprinting, and nothing tied to your files. The only things stored on your device are your theme and language preferences. Video and audio conversion downloads a ~31MB FFmpeg engine from our own CDN the first time you use it; your files are never part of that request. File size limits (100MB images, 500MB video, 200MB audio) prevent browser memory exhaustion.
about.improvement1: HEIC and AVIF decode — convert iPhone and modern web photos (lazy-loaded WASM)
about.improvement2: ePub export — convert TXT, Markdown, and HTML to e-books
about.improvement3: Animated WebP output from all video formats via FFmpeg
about.improvement4: Error boundary — caught errors show a fallback UI instead of a white screen
about.improvement5: Automated CI pipeline — typecheck, lint, test, and build on every push
about.improvement6: Real-time FFmpeg progress tracking for video/audio conversions
about.improvement7: File size limits with early rejection (100MB images, 500MB video, 200MB audio)
about.improvement8: FFmpeg WASM error handling with graceful failure recovery
about.improvement9: Auto-generated conversion map — no manual sync between registry and UI
about.improvement10: Extracted job management into reusable useJobManager hook
about.improvement11: i18n support with 5 languages and dynamic locale loading
about.improvement12: Dark/light theme toggle with system preference detection
about.improvement13: Preview panel with copy-to-clipboard for text results
about.improvement15: PWA support with manifest and app icons
about.improvement16: Deduplicated FFmpeg progress tracking and MIME-type logic across video/audio conversion
about.improvement17: Unit test suite covering converters, job management, and i18n
